evidence: REAL GATE IN GATE DIMENSIONS: scoring.toml:1-3 sets render=0.0, constraints=0.0; both gate judge.toml use aggregation="all_pass" with one binary criterion; score.py:41 gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor), :48 reward 0.0 unless gates pass, :83 exit 1 on gate failure; test.sh:213-227 runs gates then score.py before the scored suite. tests/gates/render/judge.toml hro_gate_render requires a wrong password to leave the visitor signed out, then a seeded Recruiter to sign in and see 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' (auth leg + positive control after the negative, render/prompt.md:9). tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared requires UI creation of a job (title, team, hiring manager, 2 places) and candidate (name, email, source), then 'In a new independent empty browser context sign in as the Observer ... find that same job and exactly one card ... A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate' (server-backing leg). Fields match hireops_rules.md:27-31; Observer read rights match hireops_rules.md:18. IN-DIMENSION GATE IN EVERY SCORED PROMPT: functional/prompt.md:9-13 ('Global browser gate and independent scoring' with the same recruiter-create / Observer-independent-context readback; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'); polish/prompt.md:9-12 (same check; 'gives binary0 throughout'); visual/prompt.md:9-12 (same check; 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'). Criterion types match the zeroing wording: all 39 functional and 5 polish criteria are type=binary; all 5 visual are likert points=5 with 5..1 anchors (no 0 anchor), so 'raw 1' is the correct minimum. Each prompt then requires independent per-criterion scoring after the gate passes - no partial credit when the gate fails (quality-checks.md:125 defect absent). NO SAME-ORIGIN: grep of task/tests, instruction.md and environment/instructions for 'same-origin|same origin|origin' finds only functional/judge.toml:200 'the replayed out-of-date move of F', no origin requirement; instruction.md:13 explicitly allows CDN fonts/scripts. The gates check server backing by independent-context readback, not by origin, consistent with quality-checks.md:147. TOOL FEASIBILITY: gates rely on browser_run_code_unsafe to open a second context; tests/Dockerfile:19 pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and scripts/check_hireops_mcp.cjs:75-76 asserts that tool name exists (and browser_run_code does not) under the same pin; NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:316 records that --isolated still allows it. I did not run that script (no Docker in this assignment). GOLDEN FEASIBILITY (scripted, not judge): workspace.cjs:230-239 shows wrong password refused ('do not match'), Rafael signs in, opens a job with Team/Hiring manager/Interview places via labelled UI controls and adds candidates; :429-441 shows the Observer in a separate browser.newContext reading the board; results/workspace.json all 21 groups passed, page_errors []. WEAK-APP PROBES: (a) static shell or blank page - fails render gate (no usable workspace after sign-in) and every in-dimension gate; (b) app that accepts any password - fails hro_gate_render's negative leg, which is paired with the positive sign-in control; (c) localStorage-only SPA that renders seeded data - fails hro_gate_shared and all three scored gates because the Observer in a fresh empty context cannot see the new job/card; (d) server-backed but in-memory store (no SQLite) - passes the gate, but that is a correct gate outcome: durability is graded by hro_restart in a scored dimension (REVIEW_POLICY 'Keep unrelated difficulty in scored outcomes'). CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBES: per-job board needing a job picker, select- or free-text source field, missing wrong-password message (explicitly 'welcome but not required'), CDN-hosted UI assets, API on any route layout - none is excluded by the gate wording; scored gates name no routes/selectors and 'another working staff account is acceptable' if Aud's account misbehaves. OBSERVATIONS (Note-level, not defects for this row): (1) task prompts drop the template line 'External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed and are not a failure'; no prompt requires same-origin, so this is not a violation, but restoring an explicit CDN allowance would harden public-network intent (P3). (2) The scored in-dimension gates are stricter than the template's reachability/sign-in gate (they repeat the backend create+readback), which spends judge budget three extra times; workload is unmeasured. (3) The 'NOT EXERCISED - evaluator/tool limitation' clause makes a tool failure during a gate zero the reward; it is honestly labelled rather than a false pass. RESIDUAL RISK (why risk=true): no full configured RewardKit/claude-code judge run of the gates or scored gates on these frozen bytes exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'), the browser_run_code_unsafe independent-context recipe was not exercised by an LLM judge on this candidate, and the Likert-1-normalizes-to-zero claim in visual/prompt.md:12 depends on harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 normalization which I could not inspect locally (rewardkit not installed); its effect is limited because the render/constraints gates already zero the reward for any app failing the same check.
